FLEXOR.gloss: a skeletal muscle whose contraction bends a joint
FLEXOR.definition: A skeletal muscle whose contraction bends a joint.

ROLE.gloss: the actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group
ROLE.definition: The actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group.

FORE.gloss: front part of a vessel or aircraft
FORE.definition: Front part of a vessel or aircraft.
FORE.example: He pointed the bow of the boat toward the finish line.

ORE.gloss: a mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined
ORE.definition: A mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined.

REF.gloss: the chief official who is expected to ensure fair play
REF.definition: (sports) the chief official (as in boxing or American football) who is expected to ensure fair play.

FOX.gloss: alert carnivorous mammal with pointed muzzle and ears and a bushy tail
FOX.definition: Alert carnivorous mammal with pointed muzzle and ears and a bushy tail; most are predators that do not hunt in packs.

LORE.gloss: knowledge gained through tradition or anecdote
LORE.definition: Knowledge gained through tradition or anecdote.
LORE.example: Early peoples passed on plant and animal lore through legend.
